mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness accelerates corporate wage pressures and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 305.0 (as of t-1mo), it signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
